clusters.pick_reason: PR #2032 fixes a strictly broader set of cases: its _should_pre_parse_json helper uses a SIMPLE_TYPES whitelist (str, int, float, bool, NoneType) and skips pre-parsing for any union whose args are all simple types — covering Optional[str], str|int, str|float|None, etc. PR #2554's _annotation_accepts_str is narrower: it only skips pre-parsing for bare str and Optional[str] (unions where all non-None args are exactly [str]), so unions like str|int would still be JSON-parsed, potentially coercing "42" to an integer. PR #2032's whitelist approach is more semantically principled and avoids that class of coercion bug for all primitive-only unions, not just the Optional[str] case.
